semantics.identity: API-wide lowercase D-format nonempty CorrelationId, unique across actors/actions/Candidates
semantics.actor: The initiating caller is included in the canonical request fingerprint; Receipt owner is infrastructure ownership supplied by the bounded SYSTEM organization service and is not business actor attribution. Candidate owner and explicit actor fields on business evidence remain the initiating caller.
semantics.fingerprint: SHA-256 of versioned length-delimited canonical validated inputs including initiating caller and CorrelationId; no raw request retained
semantics.privacy: Fingerprints are sensitive evidence, not anonymization. Random correlation identity is included; receipt row access remains least-privileged. No additional secret or key-management dependency is introduced.
semantics.result: Successful transaction retains derived original previous/current status and optional effect IDs; Applied is implicit. Replay returns DuplicateReplay plus those persisted values.
semantics.retention: No deletion or expiration authorized; no shorter replay lifetime introduced.
semantics.mutability: Append only through the validated synchronous operation. The local Phase 5A source uses SYSTEM writes behind an exact operation mutation matrix; production direct-write denial is intended to come from Dataverse role privileges. ProtectCandidateCore source is retained but superseded as the production security boundary; deployed privilege and registration state are not changed by this source update.
semantics.navigation: Not added to srapp or end-user navigation.
semantics.access: No role/user/team grants. The local handler reads and writes receipts through SYSTEM, so no user-facing Receipt privilege is required by that source path. Read-only VN LMV IT metadata confirmed the live API currently uses prvWriteos_sr_cand and that prvReados_sr_cand exists and is already present on the unassigned BSO role. The local API contract targets prvReados_sr_cand; the live API privilege and protected-table role grants remain unchanged pending the bounded Phase 5A update.
semantics.candidateCreateReplay: Candidate reference is filled after Candidate creation in the same transaction, with creation payload fingerprint preserved despite later profile edits.
